scientific_integrity: The exact sign pattern and scaling laws have analytic proofs; finite independently reconstructed spectral calculations are reproducibility checks, not proofs over all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the unweighted four-vertex path and positive real spectral powers; no general graph or weighted-graph theorem and no external priority certification.
title: Reentrant endpoint signs and separated recovery scales for spectral-power heat on a four-vertex path
